label: OF3 code + OpenFold3 openbind weights, no templates
notes: Third arm: the OpenFold3 CODEBASE on the openbind weights, against the same
alignments the AF3 arms used. scripts/09_build_of3_inputs.py converts the stage-03
input JSONs into OF3 query JSONs, so no MSA is recomputed.
WEIGHTS. This is the openbind checkpoint in its native OF3 serialisation
(of3-ob-2025-06-30-174k.pt). af3_openbind runs the SAME parameters ported into
AlphaFold3's format inside the container's /models. So af3_openbind vs this arm is
a code comparison at fixed weights — assuming the port is faithful, which is what
the port itself claims and is not re-verified here.
use_templates=false, and it is not optional: the converter emits no
template_cif_paths, so OF3 is run with --use-templates=false and the whole
comparison is done templates-off. Template conversion is possible but fiddly and
fails silently when wrong; it is kept out of this repository (see the docstring of
scripts/09_build_of3_inputs.py). run_workflow.sh refuses an of3 config with
use_templates=true rather than running one that quietly has none.
RECYCLES. OF3 exposes no --num-recycles flag; num_recycles is set once in its
architecture config (openfold3/projects/of3_all_atom/config/model_config.py) to 3,
with no preset in that directory overriding it. That is the same value the AF3 arms
pin, so recycles are matched across engines. num_recycles is recorded here for
provenance and is NOT passed on the command line.
num_diffusion_samples and model_seed ARE passed, and match the AF3 arms (5, 42).
of3_src / of3_env / ckpt are cluster paths; override them without editing this
file via AF3OF3_OF3_SRC, AF3OF3_OF3_ENV and AF3OF3_OF3_CKPT. runner_yaml is
resolved relative to the repository when it is not absolute.
